name: Zelvraak the Unbreathing

abilities.description: The center of the room is always cursed and deals continuous high (?) damage.[verification needed]

abilities.name: Slash
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing very high physical damage and applies "Necrotic Revenant".

abilities.name: Necrotic Spear
abilities.description: Basic ranged attack dealing very high frost damage and applies "Necrotic Revenant".

abilities.name: Necrotic Revenant
abilities.description: Deals high magic damage over (?) seconds.

abilities.name: Necrotic Wave
abilities.description: Zelvraak's charged heavy attack dealing massive magic damage in a cone. The tank must absolutely turn Zelvraak away from the group and block this attack.

abilities.name: Flesh Abominations
abilities.description: At the start of the fight and after the "Banished" phase ends, a Flesh Abomination is summoned.

abilities.name: Terrified
abilities.description: Zelvraak channels a massive fear spell dealing moderate frost damage over time which covers the whole room. You must turn away from him when it unleashes it, otherwise you are feared.

abilities.name: Drowning Waters
abilities.description: At probably 90% health and after the "Banished" phase ends, Zelvraak casts a spell which appears like whirlpools on the ceiling of the room and each one creates a Sea Orb. In Normal difficulty there is only one, in veteran there are two and in veteran hard mode there are four. The sea orbs appear at the ceiling and slowly fall. If one of them reaches the ground, all players are killed by lethal frost damage. They cannot be destroyed but any hit will send them right to the ceiling. You must constantly check them in order to survive.

abilities.name: The Afterlife/Banished
abilities.description: When Zelvraak reaches 50% Health, he becomes invincible, untargetable and stops all mechanics. All players will have their screen darkened, their character appearing ghostly and they cannot see each other. Fractured Souls slowly fly towards Zelvraak at the center of the room and you must destroy them. You are dealt continuous moderate frost damage but yellow-glowing ghosts are seen wandering the room, if you touch them, you are healed over 4 seconds and get a stack of "Soul Infusion"/"Speed Increase" for 10 seconds, each stack giving +25% movement speed. After enough time has passed, the fight with Zelvraak resumes.

abilities.name: Inferno
abilities.description: Deals moderate-high flame damage. Must be interrupted

abilities.name: Split
abilities.description: Zelvraak splits into four Illusory Specters. You must interrupt all of them and block the subsequent attack if any remain uninterrupted, otherwise each one deals immense magic damage in a cone. Upon being interrupted they disappear then (?).

abilities.name: Sundered Soul/Soul Fragmentation
abilities.description: Deal minor frost damage over time.

abilities.name: Siphon Soul
abilities.description: Deals moderate magic damage over time.

Pledge: Graven Deep: Explore Graven Deep and return Undaunted.
summary: Zelvraak the Unbreathing is a lich and former member of the Druids of Galen. He serves as the final boss of Graven Deep and can be found in the central core of the Tempest Observatory section. In life, his name was Saer. He was a practitioner of necromancy, but ascended to lichdom within the ruin's depths, entombing his fellow druids that accompanied him within. He is responsible for the disappearances of sailors around Graven Deep, utilizing the Dwarven weather machine to draw ships to their doom for his dark purposes.
